description: This file defines a template class 'NoEncryption' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, which implements a WebSocket connection that does not use encryption. It includes methods for setup, adding protocol to an address, and setting authentication state. It is part of a WebSocket client implementation with logging features.

classes.name: NoEncryption
classes.description: A template class representing a non-encrypted WebSocket connection with basic setup, addressing, and authentication mechanisms.

methods.name: NoEncryption
methods.description: Constructor that logs creation of a not encrypted WebSocket instance.

methods.name: ~NoEncryption
methods.description: Destructor that logs destruction of the WebSocket instance.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the WebSocket connection, with a log indicating no encryption is used.

methods.name: addProtocolToAddress
methods.description: Prepends 'ws://' to the provided address to form a WebSocket URL.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Sets the connection as successfully authenticated in the provided result object.
